content.name: Dark One's Blessing
entries: When you reduce an enemy to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum of 1 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52|Temporary Hit Point}). You also gain this benefit if someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.
